dataset.name: High-risk Wilms tumor (TARGET-WT)
dataset.description: Public GDC-harmonized bulk RNA-seq from primary TARGET high-risk Wilms tumors with an overall-survival contract from diagnosis.
dataset.cohort_context: Pediatric high-risk Wilms tumor in TARGET-WT. Only primary tumors are eligible; normal kidney, recurrent tumor and metastatic tumor are excluded before one RNA profile is selected per patient.
dataset.publication_citation: NCI TARGET High-Risk Wilms Tumor project

metadata.source_program: Therapeutically Applicable Research to Generate Effective Treatments (TARGET)
metadata.sample_selection_note: Primary Tumor is the only allowed sample type. Normal, recurrent and metastatic files are rejected before deterministic patient-level selection.
metadata.excluded_material: Six Solid Tissue Normal, five Recurrent Tumor and one Metastatic RNA files at the source cutoff.
metadata.treatment_note: Primary tumor denotes specimen origin and does not by itself prove treatment-naive status.
metadata.endpoint_note: OS is measured from diagnosis by the GDC survival endpoint and is interpreted within high-risk Wilms tumor only.

expression.label: log2(TPM + 1)
expression.mapping_source: GDC STAR-counts GENCODE v36 gene_id and gene_name fields
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Distinct Ensembl gene identifiers sharing one supplied symbol are excluded rather than merged implicitly.
expression.scale_note: The GDC STAR-counts files supply non-negative tpm_unstranded values. TRACE Explorer applies log2(TPM + 1) once.

endpoints.label: Overall survival
endpoints.time_origin: Diagnosis as implemented by the GDC survival endpoint
